About us
We have over 30 years in business. Our team has 25 years of experience.

Basic Qualifications
- A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science + four (4) years of experience administering Linux systems
- OR a Master's degree + two years of experience administering Linux systems
- A minimum of one year of experience automating releases.

Preferred Qualifications
- Ten years of cloud experience.
- Eight (8) years of experience working on a platform team.

Benefits
We offer 3 years of paid professional development credits.
